judges: Honourable Mr. Justice Soumitra Saikia J.
trial_court: Additional District Judge, Sonitpur, Title Suit (M) No. 30/2016
case_name: Adhir Chandra Das vs Smt. Rakhi Dey
facts_of_case: The respondent-wife filed a petition for divorce under section 13(1)(ib) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955, which was dismissed by the trial court. The petitioner-husband has appealed against this decision.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the applicant to establish that the expenses incurred are reasonable and necessary.
legal_principles.held: It is averred in the application that the opponent-original appellant is paying only Rs. 2,000/- per month as maintenance allowance to the applicant and her son

legal_principles.principle: The court may direct the payment of litigation costs to a party if it is necessary for them to contest the case.
legal_principles.held: It is therefore, humbly prayed that this Hon'ble Court may be pleased to admit this Application and further be pleased to direct the appellant/respondent to pay the litigation cost

outcome.final_order: The application is admitted and the respondent-appellant is directed to pay litigation cost to the applicant.
